statement.zh: 教科文与综合将恰高·占比尔（Dur-Untash）表述为中埃兰塔庙与相关圣区（UNESCO 113；Potts 2016）。
statement.en: UNESCO and syntheses frame Tchogha Zanbil (Dur-Untash) as a Middle Elamite ziggurat and sacred precinct (UNESCO 113; Potts 2016).
